rules: relation identity is stable and distinct from endpoint identities
cross-domain relation does not transfer endpoint ownership
relation assertion owner must be explicit
confidence must be finite 0..1 when present
relation qualifiers are part of semantic meaning and therefore DBR-tracked when canonical
inverse/symmetric semantics must be declared in registry rather than guessed
temporal/spatial/configuration qualifiers are mandatory when the relation would otherwise be ambiguous
contradictory relations may coexist with explicit epistemic/evidence state until resolved
process ordering is explicit through PRECEDES rather than inferred from filenames or row order
risk/failure relationships retain cause/effect/mitigation as separate typed edges
generic provenance edges may be reused across domains but their evidence/authority qualifiers remain scoped
